title: Stop wrong-type alternate version cleanup from recursing
body:
Removing an alternate version stored under the generic `Video` id went through the full `DeleteItem`, which saves the primary version. Saving the primary resolves its local alternates again, and the stale row is only dropped at the very end of `DeleteItem`, so `ResolveAlternateVersion` found the same item again and recursed until the stack ran out.

**Changes**
* Drop the stale wrong-type alternate row directly instead of routing it through DeleteItem, whose primary-version save re-enters `ResolveAlternateVersion` before the row is gone.

**Code assistance**
Claude Opus 5 for debugging an tests

**Issues**
Fixes #18024
